verdict.rationale: dlt provides a declarative REST API framework (dlt-docs-23), an OpenAPI-spec code generator (dlt-init-openapi, dlt-docs-25/32) and generic SQLAlchemy/database connectors (dlt-docs-24/33) that let a data engineer build a connector for any long-tail API without forking the library, and a runtime probe confirms the CLI scaffold (`dlt init`) actually generates a runnable pipeline file plus secrets template (dlt-probe-rt-1). This is reinforced by first-party CLI docs (dlt-docs-10) and AI-assisted low-code building via the dlt MCP server/AI harness (dlt-docs-14, dlt-docs-17, dlt-probe-rt-2). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community evidence of someone building a genuinely novel long-tail API connector (only a verified 'chess' source scaffold was probed) and any real-world third-party validation of the OpenAPI generator's output quality.
